name: Skirk
description: Known as the Void Star, Skirk is a mysterious swordswoman from the Abyss and the last survivor of her civilization. She trained Tartaglia (Childe) in the Foul Legacy combat style and serves the enigmatic being Surtalogi, mimicking Cryo abilities through the ancient Khaenri'ahn technique known as the Seven-Shifting Serpent.
city: The Abyss (unaffiliated with any Teyvat nation)
